about_the_game:
⚠️ This is a demo of a game that is currently in active development. A new kind of horde survival roguelite — intense, innovative, and still in the works. Visuals, features, and gameplay are all evolving—what you see now may improve, change, or be replaced entirely. If something feels missing or rough, it’s probably on our list!

🔥 Clicker Heroes meets Vampire Survivors

Iconic is a frentic lane-based horde survival roguelite with innovative gameplay that rewards nimble clicking, fast reactions, and smart tactics under time pressure.

The goal is to defend three combat lanes against waves of enemies by placing shields, actively attacking the enemies, and utilizing the available upgrades and supply.

🔧 Tactical, Skill-Based Action

Unlike common idle games with a similar setup, Iconic has a focus at rewarding actual player skill and understanding. The game demands your full attention—enforcing you to act decisively, think tactically, and make smart use of your abilities and power-ups to survive.

🧠 Deep Meta-Progression

In addition, Iconic offers a complex meta game progression system and a variety of different game modes that makes it much more appealing and diverse than the typical grind-heavy horde survival roguelite titles currently on the market.

🎮 Smash. Slam. Repeat.

Click hard, click fast. Wipe out waves of enemies, juggle lanes, and keep the chaos under control. It’s all about quick moves and well timed hits.

And don’t worry—they’re just icons!
